capabilities: Formats Fountain scripts as you type
Exports stage plays as PDFs in house styles
Manages frozen drafts, cuts and rehearsal pages
Outlines beats and scenes with a beat map
extras: Full documentation hosted at timothydsmith.github.io/obsidian-fountain-stage; only one Fountain plugin can be enabled at a time, so Fountain must be turned off first.
problem: Obsidian cannot format Fountain markup or export stage plays to PDF, and its search and outline skip .fountain files.

relations.evidence: Only one plugin can open .fountain files at a time.

summary: Stage-play writing tool for Fountain scripts: live formatting, outline, cast and draft tools, and PDF export in house styles.
